auth login.stdout:
Store an API token, or run the device flow. Off a TTY, pass --token or --device.

Usage:
  acme auth login [flags]

Flags:
  --device                      Use the OAuth device flow (never prompts)
  --json                        Print one JSON document on stdout
  --quiet                       Print identifiers only
  --no-color                    Disable ANSI color (also NO_COLOR)
  --no-input                    Fail instead of prompting
  --yes                         Confirm destructive actions without a prompt
  --dry-run                     Print the request and send nothing
  --debug                       Verbose logs to stderr, redacted
  --timeout <seconds>           Request timeout in seconds (default: 30; env: ACME_TIMEOUT)
  --profile <name>              Config profile (env: ACME_PROFILE)
  --org <id>                    Override the org for this command (env: ACME_ORG)
  --project <id>                Override the project for this command (env: ACME_PROJECT)
  --api-version <version>       Override the pinned API version (env: ACME_API_VERSION)
  --base-url <url>              Override the API base URL (env: ACME_BASE_URL)
  --allow-http                  Allow plain http for a non-loopback host
  --token <token>               API token (prefer ACME_TOKEN) (env: ACME_TOKEN)
  -h, --help                    Show help

Examples:
  acme auth login --token $ACME_TOKEN
  acme auth login --device

Related:
  acme auth status
  acme whoami

project list.stdout:
List projects in the current org. Returns summary fields; use --full for full objects.

Usage:
  acme project list [flags]

Flags:
  --limit <n>                   Results per page (default: 50)
  --cursor <cursor>             Continue after this cursor
  --all                         Fetch every page (cap: 10,000)
  --sort <field>                Sort field; prefix - for descending
  --filter <key=value>          Exact match filter
  --search <text>               Server-side text search
  --status <status>             Filter by status: active, paused, archived
  --owner <email>               Filter by owner email
  --since <time>                Created at or after (RFC 3339 or 24h)
  --until <time>                Created at or before (RFC 3339 or 24h)
  --fields <id,name,status>     Project top-level keys
  --full                        Return full objects instead of summaries
  --json                        Print one JSON document on stdout
  --quiet                       Print identifiers only
  --no-color                    Disable ANSI color (also NO_COLOR)
  --no-input                    Fail instead of prompting
  --yes                         Confirm destructive actions without a prompt
  --dry-run                     Print the request and send nothing
  --debug                       Verbose logs to stderr, redacted
  --timeout <seconds>           Request timeout in seconds (default: 30; env: ACME_TIMEOUT)
  --profile <name>              Config profile (env: ACME_PROFILE)
  --org <id>                    Override the org for this command (env: ACME_ORG)
  --project <id>                Override the project for this command (env: ACME_PROJECT)
  --api-version <version>       Override the pinned API version (env: ACME_API_VERSION)
  --base-url <url>              Override the API base URL (env: ACME_BASE_URL)
  --allow-http                  Allow plain http for a non-loopback host
  --token <token>               API token (prefer ACME_TOKEN) (env: ACME_TOKEN)
  -h, --help                    Show help

Examples:
  acme project list --limit 5
  acme project list --status active --sort -created_at --json
  acme project list --all --fields id,name

Related:
  acme project get <id>
  acme project create --name web
